title: RSF Regains Kulbus, West Darfur, After SAF-Allied Joint Force Withdraws
detail: The RSF regained Kulbus, West Darfur, on July 10, 2026, just ten days after SAF-allied Joint Forces had claimed the Chad-border town on June 30. RSF reinforced its assault with armor redeployed from El Geneina, Saraf Omra, and Kabkabiya before the offensive; residents fled toward Chad as Joint Forces withdrew. The seesaw control of Kulbus illustrates the fluid, contested nature of the West Darfur front even as SAF made gains elsewhere (Blue Nile's Kurmuk, recaptured July 8).

title: Burhan: Sudan Will Reject Any Peace Proposal That Fails to Ensure Security, Stability
detail: Speaking after Friday prayers in Umm Marrahi, north of Omdurman, on July 10, 2026, Sovereignty Council chairman Gen. Abdel Fattah al-Burhan said: 'Anything that does not satisfy the Sudanese people or achieve their security and stability, we will neither pursue nor accept... we will hand over this state only on the basis of a national consensus among all Sudanese.' Sudan's formal response to the US-brokered peace plan, delivered around this time, demanded full RSF withdrawal from held territory and UN-supervised disarmament and demobilization as preconditions — a position that set up the incompatible responses from SAF and RSF that stalled the framework through mid-July.
